contract: offline artifact / fault-injection corpus (fix-dv-19.06) for error-tracking — last of the DV-19 family. Each case injects a fault, runs a state/output ORACLE (not a provider stub judging itself), records exit/trace/environment. DV-19: the counterexample FAILS pre-fix, PASSES post-fix, verified by STATE/OUTPUTS, release-tied.
release_tie: the fix ships in a tagged release; a counterexample that passes pre-fix is not a fix

environment.note: Sentry/transport stubs are inputs, never the oracle

cases.fault: the reference string scrubber requires a non-empty username, missing redis://:pw@ and bot-token URLs
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (redis://:pw@host and /bot<id>:<token>/ reach the transport unredacted)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (every canary — empty-username redis, AMQP, bot path, access_token, nested — is scrubbed)

cases.fault: recovery rules give opposite actions for a revoked session (restart vs stop)
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a revoked session restarts forever — an infinite crash loop, alert storm)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (one actionable alert, work stopped, bounded retries, no crash loop)
